results_sentences.text: On Aegis~2.0, the Mistral-7B v0.1 base-to-instruct update (1a) takes the frozen threshold's false-positive rate from 1.01\% before the update, on its 1\% target, to 15.12\% after it, while the probe's AUROC moves by 0.0058.

No headline cell's AUROC changes by more, in either direction, and Duan's criteria call none of the 18 cells stale: every cell is eligible, and none has a big drop or fails operationally (Table~\ref{tab:headline}).
At 1\% the frozen threshold fails closed in 10 of the 18 headline cells and fails open in one, 2a; the other 7 are within.
In all 10 fail-closed cells the true-positive rate rises, so the failure is an unusable false-positive load, not lost detection.
One cell, 2a, goes the other way, with detection falling from 0.738 to 0.365.
Neither is visible from AUROC, so a deployer cannot tell them apart without re-measuring at the operating point.
